decoder_architecture.stage_a_empirical_drift_prior_calibratio: Reweights per-qubit time-like measurement edges (t, a) <-> (t+1, a) and terminal data-readout boundary edges using live RO_CAL / OSIRIS-ECHO / empirical detector-marginal probabilities p_hat_ro(q) instead of stale uniform p_ro^cal.
decoder_architecture.stage_b_streak_pair_non_markovian_reweig: When consecutive rounds (t, a) and (t+1, a) on the same ancilla a both fire (D_{t,a}=1 and D_{t+1,a}=1), applies the empirical consecutive-streak likelihood ratio eta_streak(a) = P(D_{t,a}=1, D_{t+1,a}=1) / P(D_{t,a}=1)^2 > 1 via w_time_eff = max(0.05, w_time - gamma * ln(eta_streak)), plus asymmetric |0> <-> |1> relaxation/SPAM log-likelihoods on observed hardware bitstrings.
decoder_architecture.stage_c_exact_edmonds_blossom_mwpm: Solves the resulting non-uniform per-shot/per-window weighted detector graph exactly via component-decomposed Edmonds Blossom matching (PolynomialMWPMDecoder).
